up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human target CHEMBL2292 (Dual specificity tyrosine-phosphorylation regulated kinase 1A). Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, target_name, and organism. Only include rows where the compound has a valid SMILES string and the associated document has a PubMed ID or DOI. Ensure the activity values are exact (standard_relation = '=') and in nanomolar units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2292'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) IS NOT NULL
